title: Director of Quality On-site
text:
Lead with quality. Inspire excellence. Shape the future of aviation!
 
 
Drive continuous improvement, lead quality initiatives, and ensure engines and components meet the highest industry and FAA standards.
 
 
Bring your leadership and expertise to a role where every detail matters. Fly with us and take your career to new heights!
 
 
**Tasks**
Your main tasks include, among others:
 
 

* Provide leadership to institutionalize the process in accordance with organizational goals and objectives with focus on Continuous Improvement
* Provide leadership for problem resolution to facilitate continuous improvements and improved working relationships
* Work within established organizational objectives. Accomplishes results through individual contributions as well as participation on cross-functional teams. Develop long-term strategies to build a world class organization
* Apply total quality management tools and approaches to analytical and reporting processes within each department
* Perform other duties as assigned by the President - Chief Executive Officer. These duties may include assignments in job classifications other than the primary assignment

**Benefits**

* up to 60 Sick Days
* Commuter Benefits
* 15-20 Vacation Days
* Education
* Short Disability
* Long Disability
* Flight privileges
* Healthcare
* 401k plan
* Flex Holidays
* Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Family Policy

**Requirements**
As the
**Director of Quality**
you must fulfill the following requirements:
 
 

* Bachelor’s degree required
* Master’s degree desirable
* At least 10 years of professional experience required
* Fluency in English language required
* Must have a working knowledge of Federal Aviation Administration regulations and requirements
* FAA Certified Repair Station activities
* Coordinated Agency Supplier Evaluation standards, and AS9100/ISO 9001 requirements
* Excellent business sense
* Excellent cost consciousness
* Excellent detail oriented
* Excellent quality consciousness
* Excellent safety and security
* Responsible of 10+employees
* Willingness to travel
* Must possess a valid driver’s license
* Willingness to shift work / overtime
* Manage constant time pressure
* Manage high stress levels
* Outdoor weather conditions
* Must possess a legal work permit in the U.S.
* CV/Resume required
* Company may provide relocation assistance
